6. Discussion
ThisnewpaleomagneticpolesupersedestheoneobtainedbyVizán
(1998), which was derived from the average of previous data by
Valencio and Vilas (1970) and Vilas (1974), for the Chon Aike Mag-
matic Province. The original data was determined without using or-
thogonal diagrams and principal component analyses. As previously
explained,thispreviouspolewascalculatedforrocksoftheChonAike
MagmaticProvince,whichbydefinitionhasamuchwiderdistribution
in Patagonia with a wider range of ages (158.4Ma by Féraud et al.,
1999;to178.4MabyPankhurstetal.,2000)incomparisontothenew
polepresentedherefortheChonAikeFormation(151.5to158.4Ma,
seeFig.1).

comparableageandsimilarlithologiesoutcrops(Fig.1)andhasbeen
paleomagneticallystudiedpreviously(IglesiaLlanosetal.,2003).Both,
